# WK33 · Agent chăm sóc của bệnh nhân · Trả lại cho agent

Group **WK · Agent chăm sóc (Next.js)** · page · Next.js: **exists (design W2)** (`/care/patients/[id]/release`) · account `cs_staff`

## Purpose
Care agent of one patient, tab 2: "Trả lại cho agent": return a conversation held by staff to the care agent, with a handover note and an optional temporary lower autonomy level.

## Agent and care context
- This is the only way back to AUTO: only staff return a conversation, it never expires on its own. The note is masked of personal data before saving and read by the agent in later turns. The consequence line comes from the back end in its own words.

## Who may see it
- Account in this frame: `cs_staff` (a mock account of `mock/auth.ts`; the back end decides the real matrix, the menu is a convenience).
- Gate: `care.read` for the layout; only the person who holds the conversation can return it (otherwise the note WK36).
- Roles that can open the page: owner, manager, doctor, cs_staff (care.act).
- Menu entry: not a menu entry (reached by link, redirect or the shell itself).

## Key actions
- Textarea "Ghi chú bàn giao" (500 characters)
- Radios "Mức tự chủ sau khi trả lại": keep the current level, or lower it for N days (never higher than the agent's own)
- "Trả lại cho agent" and a confirm dialog

Staff move from "controlling" to "supervising": two actions are left, accept or decline a handoff, and return the conversation to the agent.
- Two areas: care administration under `/admin/care/*` (menu section "Care agent": skills and shifts, 24/24 on-call numbers, depth matrix, SLA and send window, alerts) and per-patient supervision under `/care/*` (handoff queue, timeline, return to agent, tell the agent).
- How to reach it (mock BE, `pnpm dev:mock`): sign in as the mock account `cs_staff` → open `/care/patients/7/release`; it must show "Trả lại cho agent".

## Business rules
- (notice on the page) "Hệ quả: Agent tiếp tục ở mức L2 (trả lời câu hỏi thường gặp có nguồn trích dẫn). Nhắc lịch đã tạm dừng được rà soát, chỉ gửi lại khi còn phù hợp."
- Control state per patient: AUTO (the agent answers or acts by its autonomy level L0 to L2; staff supervise the timeline and approve drafts) → HANDOFF_ROUTING (the agent is silent towards the patient except one template holding message, summarises for the candidate, runs the routing loop) → STAFF (the agent does not react, sends no scheduled reminders; it observes and drafts suggestions that are not sent). Only a staff member returns a conversation to AUTO (PLAN-AI01-M section 5).
- The agent decides to hand over by itself (skill `handoff`): depth D1 administrative, D2 standard care, D3 mild expected symptom, D4 medical judgement, D5 red flag. Defaults: D1 answers from L1, D2 answers from L2 with a source, D3 draft plus approval, D4 always calls a person, D5 calls a doctor at once without calling the model. The matrix that holds these numbers is configuration and carries "Chờ bác sĩ duyệt" until a doctor approves it (section 6).
- The candidate chain is 3 to 5 people and its last element is always the 24/24 on-call Zalo number, kept in the database, never in code. Default SLA: urgent 5 minutes, normal 30 minutes, outside working hours until the start of the next shift (section 7).
